text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...God, dammit! 
Again...?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why...? We haven't been matching up at all 
this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Espo-san and the others...? Looks like 
they're practicing their ensemble, but...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah... Hey, step over here for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-... I'm so-so-so-so sorryyy...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... no... that's not what I meant... 
..................Ah, dammit! What the 
hell am I supposed to do?!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Espo-san...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Dammit! I gotta come up with something... 
At this rate—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaa?! B-Buena...? 
What is it... D-Did you need something?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anything I can do to help? 
Um, if it's practice, I'd be happy to join 
you—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Shut up, stop fussing over me. 
It's not like I asked you to help out or 
anything."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanna get completely in sync and 
nail it. 
So much that people'll be blown away."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"! Is that so? In that case... you're just 
like me."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Like you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I also have people whose trust I want to 
live up to— 
people I want to look cool for."

text_block_list.name: Buena's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"So close! You'll get it next time! 
We'll be back to cheer for you!"

text_block_list.name: Buena's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Uwooooh, I believed in you, Buena-chan!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show my gratitude to those who 
cheer for me no matter how poorly I'm 
doing or what I struggle with— 
I want to put on a wonderful parade and 
make them happy."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for everyone pushing me forward, 
I can give everything I have to make it 
work. And that goes for you too, Espo—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I just thought... maybe that's the kind 
of Umamusume you'd want your supporting 
fans to see."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot, you couldn't be more wrong! 
It's for my mom!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Your mom?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"—...Ghhh! 
...Anyway! My reasons are totally 
different from yours, Buena."

text_block_list.name: Young Espoir
text_block_list.text:
『...I'm gonna get stronger. I'll take 
care of things.』

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『Hehe. That's my girl. 
Can you do your best for just a little 
while until Mommy comes home?』

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(At first, it was just a "promise" meant 
to reassure her and make her smile...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
『Just watch me! I'll run in races and be 
super amazing! 
I'm totally gonna become an awesome 
Umamusume!』

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Now that we're living apart... 
that promise is the one thing keeping us 
tightly connected.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
『They're doing something called the 
Dreamy Night Parade tonight, with tons of 
flashy lights and all.』

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『An illuminated parade, huh... When you 
were little, you marched right to the 
front of an amusement park parade on your 
own... It was so cute~』

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
『Ghhh!? ...I-I don't even remember 
that...!』

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『Oh, but Mommy remembers. It's a precious 
memory with my beloved daughter. I was too 
flustered to take photos or videos, which 
is a shame, hehe♪』

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
『... ...Then this time, I'll give you 
something to capture! 
Except it'll be of me looking totally cool 
and stylish!』

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep my promise to my mom. 
...That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah... 
I knew it, Espo-san. That really is the 
kind of person you are."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...It's settled. 
I'm going to lend you a hand, Espo-san!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Wha... Why the hell would you do that!? 
You don't have any reason to help me out, 
do you!?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to be someone who can do their 
best for others. 
I want to be someone who can lend a 
helping hand to kindhearted people."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Ghh...! I told you, I'm not being kind! 
I'm just doing what I wanna do, that's 
all."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Hehe, then I will do what I want to do 
as well. 
So that I can remain someone who pours her 
heart into what she believes in."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Ghhhhh! ...Aaargh, come on! 
Let go of me! Get off!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, fine, I get it, I get it 
already! 
Sheesh, does this honor student have to be 
so damn positive...?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Positivity is my strong point, after all. 
Let's do our best together, Espo-san♪"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Like I said! 
Stop grabbing my hand every two seconds! 
Don't cling to meee!"
